request.goal: Turn LeadFinder commercial evidence into a deterministic sales card in Callflow. When salesSegment/reasonToCall exists, show one short evidence-based opener, two discovery questions and one CTA matched to the gap: no owned site, weak direct booking, marketplace dependence or weak conversion path. Add safe objection guidance for 'ya uso Booksy/Fresha/Treatwell' (integrate, do not replace) and 'ya tengo Instagram' (owned search/direct path). Never invent facts, prices, savings or send messages. Fall back cleanly when evidence is absent. Preserve current call flow and add tests.

Turn imported LeadFinder evidence into a concise diagnosis-first call assist for peluquerías/barberías. Show 2-3 factual why-call bullets and one ~20 second opener above the call controls. Select deterministic angles from evidence: strong reviews + weak owned site, no clear direct booking, or existing Booksy/Fresha/Treatwell where the pitch is to keep the provider but add an owned Google/site conversion path. Preserve instant call-result flow and niche-demo fail-closed behavior. No auto-send, LLM, invented ROI/revenue/staff, or generic claims. Add tests for evidence-to-angle mapping and missing-data fallback.

workflow-3c5dedb5-84da-4fa4-a1d2-bc92add.goal: Fix demo routing so Callflow never sends a demo from the wrong niche. Replace the current fallback that routes any unknown niche to the Fontaneria demo with deterministic fail-closed routing. Reuse or add a small pure helper in prospect-utils.js, consume it from app.js, and add regression coverage in the existing prospect-utils test file. Fontaneria must retain its configured demo; Peluquerias and any unknown/unconfigured niche must never receive a Fontaneria demo. When no demo exists, WhatsApp must not contain a demo URL and the UI must clearly communicate that no niche demo is configured, without inventing a URL. Do not touch Apps Script, LeadFinder APIs, config, package metadata, styles, navigation, or production deployment behavior.

inspectionEvidence.summary: Inspected supplied repository contents. Recommend one bounded improvement: preserve call-outcome drafts across rendering and failed submissions, and navigate home only after confirmed success. No files changed or tests executed; authoritative main was not independently verified.
findings: In app.js, update() catches request failures and returns undefined, but the result handler unconditionally switches to home afterward. A failed outcome submission therefore exits the capture screen without confirmed persistence.

In app.js, call notes exist only in the textarea; detail() renders it empty and render() replaces app.innerHTML. Error messages, periodic refresh every 25 seconds, and visibility-triggered refresh can erase unsaved notes.
In app.js, outcome buttons have no pending-submission guard, allowing repeated clicks to issue concurrent result requests.

Recommended scope: retain outcome, notes and follow-up drafts per lead in memory, preserve them through refresh and failure, prevent concurrent submissions, and clear drafts and navigate only after confirmed success. Avoid automatic mutation retries because the supplied evidence does not establish server idempotency.

The supplied tests/prospect-utils.test.mjs covers follow-up classification and ordering, but not outcome submission or draft preservation. Add behavioral regression coverage for refresh during editing, rejected submissions retaining drafts, repeated clicks issuing one pending request, and successful submission clearing the draft and navigating home.
